title: In Vitro Neuronal Networks on High-Density Microelectrode Arrays
author: Haeb, Yamamoto, et al.
materials: Cortical tissue from healthy E18 rat cortex

steps.title: Prepare sterile mixing environment
steps.instruction: Work in a sterile area; use sterile disposable plastic Petri dishes (Ø 35 mm) and Pasteur pipettes (cut tip if needed) for all subsequent handling.

steps.title: Mix PDMS components
steps.instruction: Combine elastomer base and curing agent at a 10:1 ratio (base:cure). Weigh accurately on an analytical balance, pour the base into the sterile Petri dish, add the curing agent, and mix thoroughly for 3–5 min until the mixture is homogeneous and all bubbles are released.

steps.title: Degas PDMS mixture
steps.instruction: Place the mixture in a vacuum chamber and apply ~60 Torr pressure for 15 min to remove trapped air.

steps.title: Pour PDMS onto master mold
steps.instruction: Transfer the master mold to a new sterile Petri dish that fits its dimensions, then pour the degassed PDMS onto the mold to achieve a final thickness of 0.5–1 mm.

steps.title: Repeat degassing if needed
steps.instruction: Repeat the vacuum degassing step to eliminate any remaining bubbles between PDMS and the mold; if bubbles persist, apply gentle air pressure or repeat the vacuum step.

steps.title: Cure PDMS on hot plate
steps.instruction: Cure the PDMS by incubating the Petri dish in an oven at 70 °C for 1 h ± 10 min (acceptable range 60–70 °C for 1–2 h). Verify that the PDMS is solid and non‑sticky.

steps.title: Cut PDMS pattern
steps.instruction: Allow the cured PDMS to cool, then using a sterile scalpel under a microscope, dice the PDMS into the desired pattern and place the pieces in a new sterile Petri dish, avoiding excessive pressure on the master mold.

steps.title: Punch micro‑holes in PDMS
steps.instruction: Punch four circular cavities (Ø 2 mm) arranged in a 2 × 2 grid; the cavities are connected by microchannels 10 μm wide, 10 μm deep, and 400 μm long.

steps.title: Ethanol sterilize PDMS
steps.instruction: Immerse the PDMS device in 70 % ethanol for 1 h to sterilize.

steps.title: Rinse and UV‑irradiate PDMS
steps.instruction: Rinse the PDMS three times with sterile deionized water, place it channel‑side up in a sterile Petri dish, and expose to UV germicidal irradiation for 30 min.

steps.title: Dry PDMS and store
steps.instruction: Dry the PDMS in sterile conditions for 1–2 h; when completely dry, it is ready for attachment to the pre‑cleaned, pre‑coated HD‑MEA chip. The device may be stored sterile until use.
